description:
[Game reference] Rust launch options that work, the myths, and a Steam launch line builder. The data behind https://rust.wiki/launch-options: `groups` of options Rust (Facepunch) and Unity 6 actually read,
each with its value and what it does, plus `myths` (popular 'FPS boost' flags nothing shows Rust reads). With
`line`: `check.line` is the cleaned launch line (known options only, one forced graphics API) and `check.options`
says what each one is (`rust`, `unity`, `myth`, `unknown`, `conflict`) with any warning.

line.description: Optional: options to check and clean up, as you'd paste them into Steam.

name: get_launch_options
title: Rust launch options that work, the myths, and a Steam launch line builder
